UI_BritaArmor_NV_NeedBattery: Unequip goggles, insert a battery, then press V.
UI_BritaArmor_NV_Conflict: Disable standalone NVFramework — it overwrites fileGuidTable and breaks night vision.
UI_NVFramework_Mode_Tooltip: Choose the night-vision renderer. Single Point Light is the balanced default; Custom uses a directional cone; Zomboid Native uses the built-in night-vision effect.
UI_NVFramework_LegacySampling_Tooltip: Legacy sampling gives a denser, higher-quality light cone but costs more performance. Disable it for a lighter sparse mode on weaker PCs.
UI_NVFramework_ToggleSoundVolume_Tooltip: Volume of the night-vision on/off sounds (0 = silent, 1 = full volume).
UI_NVFramework_ToggleKey_Tooltip: Key used to toggle night vision on or off. Default: V
UI_NVFramework_DebugEditorKey_Tooltip: Key used to open the overlay editor while Debug mode is active. Default: N
UI_NVFramework_EnableBaseSound_Tooltip: Play a looping ambient hum while night vision is active.
UI_NVFramework_BaseSoundVolume_Tooltip: Volume of the ambient night-vision hum (0 = silent, 1 = full volume).
